component.name: KDE Infinite Desktop
KDE Infinite Desktop
component.summary: Turn every monitor into an infinite canvas you can pan and zoom
Macht jeden Monitor zu einer unendlichen Arbeitsfläche zum Verschieben und Zoomen

description.p: KDE Infinite Desktop is an effect for KWin, the compositor of KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland. It turns every monitor into an infinite canvas: windows are placed on a plane that you can pan and zoom freely, with the mouse, the touchpad, a touchscreen or the keyboard.

KDE Infinite Desktop ist ein Effekt für KWin, den Compositor von KDE Plasma 6 unter Wayland. Er macht jeden Monitor zu einer unendlichen Arbeitsfläche: Fenster liegen auf einer Ebene, die du mit Maus, Touchpad, Touchscreen oder Tastatur frei verschieben und zoomen kannst.

ul.li: Pan by dragging the empty desktop, with the middle mouse button or with touchpad gestures
Verschieben durch Ziehen des leeren Desktops, mit der mittleren Maustaste oder mit Touchpad-Gesten
Zoom with the mouse wheel, pinch gestures or keyboard shortcuts
Zoomen mit dem Mausrad, Pinch-Gesten oder Tastenkürzeln
A separate canvas for every monitor and, optionally, for every virtual desktop
Eine eigene Arbeitsfläche pro Monitor und optional pro virtuellem Desktop
Momentum, edge panning, background grid and a zoom indicator
Schwung, Verschieben am Bildschirmrand, Hintergrundraster und Zoom-Anzeige
Safe mode that keeps the desktop usable if something goes wrong
Sicherheitsmodus, der den Desktop benutzbar hält, falls etwas schiefgeht

description.p: The effect needs KDE Plasma 6.8 or newer on Wayland. It has to be rebuilt after every KWin update, because KWin only loads plugins built for its exact version.
Der Effekt benötigt KDE Plasma 6.8 oder neuer unter Wayland. Nach jedem KWin-Update muss er neu gebaut werden, weil KWin nur Plugins lädt, die für genau seine Version gebaut wurden.

screenshot.caption: Zoomed out: every window live and readable, wallpaper and panel stay still

description.p: The project is now called KDE Infinite Desktop (until 0.5.1: KDE Infinit Desktop). Settings, shortcuts, notes and canvases are taken over automatically.

Notes open with their Markdown source and a pencil button switches to the formatted text, right click opens the note's own menu everywhere, the hint text wraps, and menus and tool tips follow the color scheme.
Notes with Markdown on the canvas, groups of applications that open together at their place, areas that grow with their windows, a map of the canvas and a canvas menu.

Menus and dropdowns of Steam and Wine programs appear in the right place while zoomed out, moving Steam while zoomed out works reliably, clicks no longer go astray after opening submenus, and floating panels stay floating.
X11 programs such as Steam and launchers under Wine/Proton can be clicked and moved while zoomed out.
Steam and launchers under Wine/Proton can be moved while zoomed out. Their splash windows no longer end the zoom, and with "New windows return to 100 %" switched off, starting them keeps the zoom.

The settings app looks for new versions, shows their release notes and installs the update. The installer no longer asks for a missing SVG package on KDE neon and says when logging out and back in is needed.

Windows that draw their own title bar (browsers, Steam, Wine/Proton programs) can be moved while zoomed out. Games in borderless fullscreen mode are treated like fullscreen windows. Zooming with Meta and the mouse wheel no longer opens the launcher.
First release: infinite canvas effect, System Settings module and settings app.
